headline: Fresh Fighting Reopens Several Strategic Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns put fresh motion on Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf, while the heaviest fighting remains concentrated in Clahstra, Deadlands, Weathered Expanse and other divided sectors. Oarbreaker recorded two base events in the latest two hours, with casualties and enlistments sharply accelerating; its ledger stands at seven Colonial-held bases and two Warden-held. Stlican Shelf also logged two recent events, including a neutralization and a Warden capture, though its casualty and enlistment rates are now cooling; all nine bases remain Warden-held. Deadlands has gone quiet in the latest two hours but recorded three events across six hours and seven during the day, leaving four Warden bases against seven Colonial. Farranac Coast likewise shows no fresh two-hour event, yet three in six hours and 15 in 24, with ownership divided four Warden to seven Colonial. Godcrofts has five events in six hours and 15 across the day, despite an eight-to-one Warden majority. Clahstra has no recorded base movement, but combat has surged dramatically in the latest two hours, marking it as a front to watch.
